_rpc_note: Igra JSON-RPC, used ONLY for block-pinned eth_getCode in the recipient classifier (fixtures/classify.py). Verified 2026-09-28 to answer eth_getCode at historical block numbers.
_note: Seed wallets and incident start positions are CONFIGURATION, not query logic. Every address must be 0x + 40 hex; run.py rejects anything else before it reaches SQL.

tokens._note: tidx has no token registry on Igra (token_metadata is empty of ERC-20s), so decimals live here. WiKAS values read via eth_call decimals()/symbol() on 2026-09-28.

contracts._note: Used to CLASSIFY to_address and called_contract (fixtures/classify.py) for human review. Never to propagate a designation. Presence in called_contract does not make an address a contract; absence from this config does not make it an EOA — a block-pinned eth_getCode decides those two, and a failed lookup stays 'unknown' (review).

hyperlane_routers._roles: A token ROUTER is what users call (F11: USDC router 0xa5b8…35e7, selector 0x81b4e8b4; burns the synthetic token — Transfer to 0x0 — and dispatches). The MAILBOX 0x3a867fcffec2b790970eebdc9023e75b0a172aa7 is a different role: sole emitter of Dispatch(address,uint32,bytes32,bytes) on Igra (2,216 dispatches, blocks 1,086,916 → 17,949,927). It is not a router and is listed under mailbox, not here.

polling._note: Never scan past synced_num from /status. Complete every page before advancing the checkpoint. A response with ok:false is a failure, not an empty page.

coverage_gaps.exits_0x3: tidx does not yet parse Igra payload type 0x3 (Exit). L2→L1 exits therefore have no L1-side provenance row. On the L2 side an exit IS visible as a native-value tx to canonical_exit (q1) — that is the observation to alert on.
coverage_gaps.l2_withdrawals: Despite its name this table holds L1→L2 ENTRIES (deposits). It must not be read as exits.
coverage_gaps.erc721: NFT Transfer events are excluded by q3 (topic3 IS NULL); not in scope for value tracking.
coverage_gaps.block_timestamp: Igra block.timestamp is synthetic (DAA-derived) and currently ~10 min behind wall clock. Use it only as an index-friendly prefilter; exact bounds are block_num. blocks.real_timestamp is the L1 wall-clock time.

state._note: Persisted bot state the pilot REQUIRES (see README 'Checkpoints and the unresolved-trace backlog'); shape in state.example.json. Two independent checkpoints: scan_checkpoint (q1+q3) and internal_checkpoint (q2). internal_checkpoint may advance through a window only when q0d reports possibly_untraced = 0 for it OR the window has been appended to unresolved_internal_ranges. Entries leave the backlog only after a trace repair (tidx backfill-traces or the trace-outcome PR) and a q2 re-run over exactly that range.
